title: Teaching summary on theft
text: With the purpose of unlawful possession, secretly steals public or private property, covering conditions such as a relatively large amount or repeated theft. This is a simplified teaching summary.

title: Teaching summary on robbery
text: Robbery of public or private property by violence, coercion, or other means. This is a simplified teaching summary.

title: Teaching summary on fraud
text: Defrauds public or private property by fabricating facts or concealing the truth, covering conditions such as a relatively large amount. This is a simplified teaching summary.

title: Teaching summary on intentional injury
text: Intentionally and unlawfully harms another person's physical health; assessment requires facts such as the degree of injury. This is a simplified teaching summary.

title: Teaching summary on causing a traffic accident
text: Violates traffic and transportation regulations and causes a major accident that results in serious injury or death or significant loss of public or private property. This is a simplified teaching summary.

title: Teaching summary on intentional homicide
text: Intentionally and unlawfully deprives another person of life. This is a simplified teaching summary.
